highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 introduces custom GPU mesh drawing alongside the Skia m159 engine.
highlights_body: The cumulative line adds mesh specifications and builders, corrects iOS and tvOS device frameworks, and improves glyph and image-filter handling. WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later.

breaking.title: Upgrade WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets. Retarget WASM applications to .NET 9 or later and use the runtime-matched assets; newer archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and upstream image and rendering corrections.

SKMeshSpecification, indexed and non-indexed builders, vertex and index buffers, and SKCanvas.DrawMesh expose SkSL-based custom meshes with uniforms and child effects. Drawing requires a GPU-backed surface; raster drawing is a no-op. Built meshes retain native resources after their source wrappers are disposed; buffer updates require 4-byte alignment.

SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp iOS and tvOS device frameworks now contain arm64 device binaries and matching platform metadata, avoiding simulator slices that could cause App Store ITMS-90087 rejection. Separate simulator frameworks retain x86_64 and arm64 support.

bullets.lead: Safer glyph masks and Vulkan allocation failure handling
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyph reloads now respect changed paths and formats, prevent sub-byte overwrites, and preserve clipped emboss-plane strides. A targeted Imagination Vulkan workaround abandons descriptor pools after host or device allocation OOM to avoid driver failures during destruction.
Matches cache-key equality to its bytewise hash, accounting for signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata so key lookup, eviction, and purge use consistent identity rules.

contributor_summaries.kdpkke: Correct iOS and tvOS device-framework binaries and metadata while preserving simulator framework support.

preview_summaries.v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22: Preview 1 brings Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. WebAssembly consumers require .NET 9 or later; non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0. WebAssembly assets now require .NET 9 or later, and iOS/tvOS device frameworks use device-only binaries and metadata while simulator support is preserved.
